imagery.attribution: USGS The National Map · public-domain aerial imagery

mappingNote: Green centers are OpenStreetMap polygon centroids; numbered routes compared with official hole diagrams and the archived USGS aerial. Retrieved 2026-10-26. No on-course survey or daily pin data. OpenStreetMap way 870888278 is incorrectly labelled 10; it is hole 1, followed by mapped holes 2-9. The other mapped 10 is the real hole 10. Hole 14 Black is 402 yards on the current card, not the older 327-yard value. Base tee sets are included; mixed-color combo tees are omitted. The card's main men's stroke-index row is used for every tee. Archival aerial imagery may predate course changes. Live yardages use coordinates, not printed tee lengths.
